mapper.sql: h.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, h.request_no AS requestNo, h.request_dt AS requestDt, ru.user_nm AS requesterName, dept.department_nm AS requestDeptName, d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, d.line_no AS lineNo, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, d.request_qty AS requestQty, d.request_delivery_dt AS requestDeliveryDt, d.use_type AS useType, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, d.request_remark AS requestRemark, d.confirm_qty AS confirmQty, d.confirm_delivery_dt AS confirmDeliveryDt, d.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, d.order_type AS orderType, oci.item_nm AS orderTypeName, d.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.currency_code AS currencyCode, d.tax_type AS taxType, d.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, d.amount AS amount, d.confirm_remark AS confirmRemark, d.order_close_at AS orderCloseAt

FROM tb_purchase_request_hd h JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt d ON d.purchase_request_id = h.purchase_request_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.user_id = h.requester_id LEFT JOIN tb_department dept ON dept.department_id = h.request_dept_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = d.use_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = d.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = d.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id
mapper.select:
SELECT h.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, h.request_no AS requestNo, h.request_dt AS requestDt, ru.user_nm AS requesterName, h.status AS requestStatus, d.line_no AS lineNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, d.request_qty AS requestQty, d.request_delivery_dt AS requestDeliveryDt, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, d.request_remark AS requestRemark FROM tb_purchase_request_hd h JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt d ON d.purchase_request_id = h.purchase_request_id AND d.tenant_id = h.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.user_id = h.requester_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = d.use_type WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND h.status IN ('REQUESTED', 'PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED') AND d.purchase_confirm_id IS NULL
AND h.request_dt >= CAST(#{fromDt} AS date)
AND h.request_dt <= CAST(#{toDt} AS date)
AND (h.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR ru.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY h.request_dt DESC, h.request_no DESC, d.line_no LIMIT 500

SELECT d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, d.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, d.purchase_confirm_id AS purchaseConfirmId FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd h ON h.purchase_request_id = d.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND d.purchase_request_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY d.purchase_request_detail_id FOR UPDATE OF d

SELECT d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, d.purchase_request_id AS purchaseRequestId, d.purchase_confirm_id AS purchaseConfirmId FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd h ON h.purchase_request_id = d.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND d.purchase_request_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT pc.purchase_confirm_id AS purchaseConfirmId, pc.tenant_id AS tenantId, pc.confirm_no AS confirmNo, pc.confirm_dt AS confirmDt, cu.user_nm AS confirmerName, pc.currency_code AS currencyCode, pc.total_amt AS totalAmt, pc.remark AS remark, pc.use_at AS useAt, uu.user_nm AS updatedByName, to_char(pc.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updatedAt FROM tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc LEFT JOIN tb_user cu ON cu.user_id = pc.confirmer_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account ula ON ula.login_code = pc.updated_by AND ula.tenant_id = pc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user uu ON uu.login_id = ula.login_id AND uu.tenant_id = ula.tenant_id WHERE pc.purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND pc.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt d ON d.purchase_request_detail_id = od.purchase_request_detail_id WHERE oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.use_at = 'Y' AND d.purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT} )

SELECT u.user_id FROM tb_login_account la JOIN tb_user u ON u.login_id = la.login_id AND u.tenant_id = la.tenant_id WHERE la.login_code = #{loginCode} AND la.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} LIMIT 1

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND g.group_code = 'PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE' AND g.use_at = 'Y' AND i.item_code = #{code} AND i.use_at = 'Y' )

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND g.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' AND g.use_at = 'Y' AND i.item_code = #{code} AND i.use_at = 'Y' )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_request_dt SET confirm_qty = #{confirmQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, confirm_delivery_dt = CAST(#{confirmDeliveryDt} AS date), warehouse_id = #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, order_type = #{orderType}, supplier_id = #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, currency_code = #{currencyCode}, tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, amount = #{amount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, confirm_remark = #{confirmRemark}, order_close_at = 'N', purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_request_detail_id = #{purchaseRequestDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND purchase_confirm_id IS NULL

UPDATE tb_purchase_request_hd h SET status = CASE WHEN s.confirmed_count = 0 THEN 'REQUESTED' WHEN s.confirmed_count = s.total_count THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'PARTIALLY_CONFIRMED' END, total_amt = s.confirmed_amt, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() FROM ( SELECT d.purchase_request_id, count(*) AS total_count, count(d.purchase_confirm_id) AS confirmed_count, COALESCE(sum(d.amount) FILTER (WHERE d.purchase_confirm_id IS NOT NULL), 0) AS confirmed_amt FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.purchase_request_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY d.purchase_request_id ) s WHERE h.purchase_request_id = s.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_purchase_request_dt d SET confirm_qty = NULL, confirm_delivery_dt = NULL, supplier_id = NULL, warehouse_id = NULL, order_type = NULL, unit_price = NULL, currency_code = NULL, tax_type = NULL, vat_included_at = NULL, amount = 0, confirm_remark = NULL, order_close_at = 'N', purchase_confirm_id = NULL, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND d.purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_purchase_confirm_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT p.unit_price AS unitPrice, p.tax_type AS taxType, p.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, p.foreign_unit_price AS foreignUnitPrice, p.currency AS foreignCurrency FROM tb_item_partner_price p WHERE p.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND p.material_id = #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND (p.customer_id = #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT} OR p.customer_id IS NULL) AND p.trade_type = '매입' AND p.use_at = 'Y' AND p.start_dt <= CAST(#{baseDt} AS date) AND (p.end_dt IS NULL OR p.end_dt >= CAST(#{baseDt} AS date)) ORDER BY (p.customer_id IS NULL), p.start_dt DESC, p.price_id DESC LIMIT 1
